title: Zvinowanikwa paPuratifomu
requiredTextNote: Mamwe ma tag emavara anodiwa uye anogara akabatidzwa (anoratidzwa asingashandike).
featuresWarning: Kudzima sarudzo idzi kunogona kubvisa masimba makuru ekunyora nekutonga.
largeSiteWarning: Saiti iyi ine mapeji akawanda. Kugadzira skeleton kunogona kutora nguva.

addPageFeatureDescription: Inobvumira kugadzira mapeji matsva kubva pabhawa repamusoro, zviito zverondedzero, uye zviito zvekutsvaga mirairo.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Inobvumira kudzima mapeji kubva pazviito zvepeji, zviito zverondedzero, nemamwe maitiro eadmin.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Inobatidza maturusi echimiro chesaiti, kusanganisira zviito zverondedzero nemabasa eadmin eChimiro.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Inoratidza kuwana Gwara reMaitiro mumaturusi eadmin nemapfupiso ekutsvaga mirairo.
insightsFeatureDescription: Inobatidza Mishumo muadmin nekutsvaga mirairo kuitira kuti maonero ekuongorora neruzivo awanikwe.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Inodzora zvikamu zveMarongerwo eSaiti zveRuzivo, Mabhuroko, nemarongerwo eMugadziri.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Inobatidza chikamu chemarongerwo eChitarisiko/Dingindira mukutonga saiti.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Inobatidza purofaira yemunyori nemarongerwo emetadata yemunyori mukutonga saiti.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Inobatidza marongerwo ekuvandudza injini yekutsvaga nemetadata mukutonga saiti.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Inoratidza zvidzoreso zvekugadzirisa metadata yepeji senge zita, aikoni, mamiriro, zviratidzo, nekukiya.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Inoratidza bhurawuza remabhuroko uye inobvumira kuwedzera mabhuroko matsva ezvirimo pakugadzirisa.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Inoratidza chikamu cheMabhuroko anozivikanwa mukati memusarudzi wemabhuroko.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Inoratidza chikamu cheMabhuroko achangoshandiswa mukati memusarudzi wemabhuroko.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Inoratidza paneru yemepu/chimiro chezvirimo zvepeji pakugadzirisa zvirimo.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Inobatidza maonero ekodhi yeHTML kuti ugadzirise markup yepeji zvakananga.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Inobatidza maitiro ekuisa mafaira nekuwana kutonga midhiya/mafaira.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Inobatidza kubatanidza midhiya yepaindaneti nesosi dzekutsvaga midhiya yekure.
communityFeatureDescription: Inobatidza mamiriro ekutsvaga mirairo ane chekuita nenharaunda nezviito zvekusvika vanhu.
